test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 28 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A book is sold at three successive discounts of 20%, 30% and 10%. The net discount in percentage is:
solution:
**Given:**

Three successive discounts: 20%, 30%, and 10%

**Formula used:**

Successive Discount Formula:

Net Discount % = A + B + C - (AB + AC + BC)/100 + (ABC)/10000

Where A = 20, B = 30, C = 10

**Calculation:**

Net Discount % = 20 + 30 + 10 - (20×30 + 20×10 + 30×10)/100 + (20×30×10)/10000

⇒ = 60 - (600 + 200 + 300)/100 + 6000/10000

⇒ = 60 - 11 + 0.6 = 49.6%

**∴ The net discount is 49.6%.**
